title: HyperSVG 2.0 capability snapshot: Snapshot
description: the call snapshot.save with {save}: on a person's trusted activation (a real press, key or pointer gesture, never a seat, timer or program; humanOnly) the live drawing of the save's picture part is saved as a local PNG. A press control's reaction makes the call (D31: an add-on adds no control kind) | addons.snapshot.saves.<name>: picture is a part, component or compound present in every drawing; filename is a plain PNG name (a letter or digit, then up to 79 letters, digits, underscore, dot or hyphen, then .png); pixelWidth 1..4096; padding 0..256 drawing units on each side (default 8); status names a text value of at least 200 characters that reports preparing, offered or the reason for a refusal | the picture freezes at the activation; text, looks, numeric motion, paint roles, gradients, clips and masks are included; use, image, filters and foreignObject content are refused, never silently left out; no external fonts or resources load; one capture runs at a time | limits: 4096 pixels per edge, 16,777,216 pixels, 20,000 source elements, 32 MiB of PNG, a 5 s render deadline | a hidden or disabled press control cannot be pressed, so it cannot save
